target_title: The Disk in the Loading Dock
summary: D013 finds a stronger benchmark object but closes too conceptually; D014 should keep the disk/loading-dock pressure while shifting to the stamped mark and above-ground facts.
strengths: Moves away from D012's route-instruction lyric toward a smaller source object.
Keeps the no-value / water hinge without infrastructure diction.
Uses blue brick guard house, concrete loading dock, and tidal disk as resistant source material.
risks: The ending explains the object as an argument: water needs something it can be wrong against.
The opening still carries route residue from D012.
The disk is allegorized through looking/stillness language instead of held as a stamped physical mark.
required_next_pressure: Use the source's primary benchmark stamping and setting facts.
Allow only a small numeric exception for the stamped object name, not for table display.
